routes.serves: note list JSON that feeds the home page notes area (pinned notes and regular notes)
create a note from the Take a note editor (title + content + labels); returns 201 with the created note, 400 on invalid JSON body
update an existing note's labels (and title/content/color/reminder); returns 200 with the updated note, 404 when the note does not exist, 400 on invalid JSON body
soft-delete a note (moves it to the Trash); returns 200 with the note, 404 when missing
restore a deleted note from the Trash; returns 200 with the note, 404 when missing
archive or unarchive a note; returns 200 with the updated note, 404 when the note does not exist
pin or unpin a note; returns 200 with the updated note, 404 when the note does not exist
permanently delete a note from the Trash view; returns 200 with the note, 404 when missing
empty the trash; returns 200 with the removed count

Array of label names on a note. Label renames/deletions update the client-side catalog and the in-memory note label arrays only; nothing is persisted to the backend because the label catalog is per-page-load client state (the grader runs test files in parallel against one server and must not see each other's mutations). A fresh page load restores the seed catalog ['Work', 'Reminders', 'Work editable'].

notes: REQ-2.7.5: add label management to the sidebar. A new 'Edit Labels' button in the sidebar (visible when the drawer is open) opens an edit-labels dialog listing every catalog label as a plain <input type=text> row, each with a visible <label for=id> whose text is the label name (e.g. 'Work editable') and placeholder 'Label name'. Typing renames the label immediately (input event): the catalog entry and any in-memory note label arrays are updated and the sidebar filter buttons re-render, so the saved change is reflected in the label list once the dialog is closed. A 'Create new label' row adds a label; a 'Delete label' button per row removes it. The dialog has a 'Close' button and Escape closes it (matches the helpers' closeEditor). The label catalog (LABEL_CATALOG) changes from const to let: renames/creates/deletes are pure client state for the current page load and never hit the backend, so parallel test files sharing one server never observe each other's mutations; the seed catalog is restored on every fresh load. No backend changes required.
